{{Quote|Based on your unorthodox entrance, I assume we share a common goal.''"<br />"''Not quite. We're here to plant a ''bomb''&mdash;and ''destroy'' everything in the vault.|Kanto Raka and Anakin Skywalker|<ref name="The Professional!" />}}
During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], a '''mission''' was made to the [[Casino/Legends|casino]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Katalla]]. [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]], [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], were to plant a bomb inside a [[Besadii/Legends|Besadii]] vault on the planet, because [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] intelligence had determined that Clan Besadii had been giving money to the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. As they were making their way underground to the vault, the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] encountered a professional [[Thief/Legends|thief]] named [[Kanto Raka]]. He told them he did not care about politics, or the war, and would help them blow up the vault in exchange for a cut of the fortune to cover his expenses. The path he led them kept them from re-entering the sewers, but they encountered five [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-series battle droid]]s, which they made short work of. The Jedi were successful in blowing up the vault, and Raka took as much of the fortune as he was able to carry.
